protocol.description:
This is a private ferriscope protocol spoken by the ferriscope Vulkan WSI layer (VK_LAYER_FERRISCOPE_wsi). Regular Wayland clients must not use it.
It derives from gamescope_swapchain_factory_v2 / gamescope_swapchain of the Gamescope project, without what only Gamescope needs, plus two events on the factory that tell the layer what the compositor can do:
- hdr_available: whether the layer should expose HDR surface formats. - xwayland_server: the identity of the Xwayland server this compositor runs, to be compared with the FERRISCOPE_XWAYLAND_SERVER_ID property on the X11 root window so the layer knows an X11 connection is to this compositor's own Xwayland.
A change to the protocol that old layers cannot ignore gets a new interface name (..._v2), not a new version of these.

event.name: hdr_available

description.summary: whether HDR swapchains can be presented

event.description:
Sent when the factory is bound and whenever the answer changes.
When available is 1 the compositor can present HDR10 (PQ) and scRGB swapchains, and the layer may expose those surface formats to the application. When 0 the layer exposes SDR formats only.

event.name: xwayland_server

description.summary: identity of the compositor's Xwayland server

event.description:
Sent when the factory is bound and whenever the answer changes.
server_id is also published as the 32-bit CARDINAL property FERRISCOPE_XWAYLAND_SERVER_ID on the root window of the compositor's Xwayland. A layer that finds the same value on the root window of its X11 connection knows that connection is to this compositor's Xwayland, and may use override_window_content with it. server_id 0 means the compositor has no Xwayland server (yet); nothing is bypassable.

arg.name: server_id
arg.summary: Xwayland server id, or 0 for none

request.name: override_window_content
request.description:
Xwayland creates a wl_surface for each X11 window. It sends a WL_SURFACE_ID client message to indicate the mapping between the X11 windows and the wl_surface objects.
This request overrides this mapping for a given X11 window, allowing an X11 client to submit buffers via the Wayland protocol. The override only affects buffer submission. Everything else (e.g. input events) still uses Xwayland's WL_SURFACE_ID.

arg.name: xwayland_server_id
arg.summary: the xwayland_server id the layer saw on the X11 root window

request.name: swapchain_feedback
request.description:
Provide swapchain feedback to the compositor.
Provides image count ahead of time, and colorspace info for HDR. The colourspace is the one the application asked for; the layer presents the images to the driver as sRGB.

arg.name: vk_engine_name
arg.summary: the application's engine name (VkApplicationInfo::pEngineName), empty if none

description.summary: Communicate the active present mode to the compositor

request.name: set_hdr_metadata

description.summary: set HDR metadata for a surface

request.description:
Forward HDR metadata from Vulkan to the compositor.
HDR Metadata Infoframe as per CTA 861.G spec.
display_primary_{red,green,blue}_{x,y} / white_point_{x,y}: Color primaries and white point, coded as unsigned 16-bit values in units of 0.00002 (0xC350 == 1.0).
max_display_mastering_luminance: Max mastering display luminance in cd/m2 (uint16, 1 cd/m2 units).
min_display_mastering_luminance: Min mastering display luminance in units of 0.0001 cd/m2.
max_cll: Max content light level in cd/m2.
max_fall: Max frame average light level in cd/m2.

request.name: set_present_time
request.description: Sets the desired presentation time for the next commit (CLOCK_MONOTONIC). Resets to 0 after commit.

arg.name: desired_present_time_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of desired present time (ns)

arg.name: desired_present_time_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of desired present time (ns)

event.name: refresh_cycle

description.summary: compositor refresh cycle for this swapchain

event.description: Fired when the compositor's refresh period changes.

arg.name: refresh_cycle_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of refresh cycle in nanoseconds

arg.name: refresh_cycle_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of refresh cycle in nanoseconds

event.name: frame_ready

description.summary: the compositor can take the next frame in time

event.description:
Sent at a compositor tick for a swapchain whose present mode is FIFO (set_present_mode, 2), when no commit of the swapchain's surface is held waiting for a tick: a frame the application starts now, and presents when done, is taken at the next tick at the latest, without queueing behind others.
A layer may use it to start the application's next frame no earlier than that, instead of letting it render ahead of the display, which only adds latency. It must not wait for it forever: the event only comes while the compositor is ticking for the surface.

description.summary: swapchain was remotely retired by the compositor
